title: Africa My Beginning
author: Ingoapele Madingoane
current_text: Africa My Beginning was banned in May 1979.

sources.quote: The first publication in the series was Ingoapele Madingoane ’s Africa My Beginning, which was banned in May 1979. The second was Call Me Not A Man by Mtutuzeli Matshoba, which was banned in November 1979.
sources.title: Staffrider magazine (1978-1993) | South African History Online

ban_rows.note: Banned 9 May 1979 under section 47(2)(e) of the Publications Act 1974 as prejudicial to State security and good order: the 22-poem collection invoked Sharpeville and Soweto, called on ancestors for liberation, and praised declared communists (Neto, Mugabe).
